meta.title: Increase Event Time: Increase event time when buyer edit permission is disabled shows permission error
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

resolved: “The catalog cannot configure or verify a distinct buyer permission specifically governing editing the submission time; c” — require_setting switches that company setting before the case and back after

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with the vendor bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer visibility configuration.
Apply the stated buyer bid-edit configuration, although it does not specifically configure submission-time editing permission.
Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Open the RFQ stage named in the case.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab before opening the event settings action.
Confirm the Responses screen is ready.
Attempt the Increase Event Time action and assert that the buyer is refused.
